name: Last extern instance deletion permits immediate template replacement
setup: $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 2; $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32; $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/myext/one; $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 2; printf released'

name: Deleting one instance retains its sibling and template reference
setup: $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32
$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/two instid 2 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; $TC -j p4template get extern_inst/ptables/myext/two | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; assert json.load(sys.stdin)==json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))'"'"' /tmp/p4tc-extlife-$TESTID.json; if $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; then exit 1; else test "$?" -eq 255; fi; $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/myext/two; $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 2; $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32; $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/myext/one; $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 2; printf released'

name: Template remains referenced until the last pipeline releases it
setup: $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32
$TC p4template create extern_inst/other/myext/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; if $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; then exit 1; else test "$?" -eq 255; fi; $TC p4template get extern_inst/other/myext/one; $TC p4template del extern_inst/other/myext/one; $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 2; $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32; $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/myext/one; $TC p4template del extern/root/myext; $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 2; printf released'

name: A live table binding prevents premature extern instance release
setup: $TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/one instid 1 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname keysz 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/one
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; $TC p4template get extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/one; if $TC p4template del extern/root/DirectCounter; then exit 1; else test "$?" -eq 255; fi; $TC p4template del table/ptables/cb/tname; $TC p4template del extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/one; $TC p4template del extern/root/DirectCounter; $TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method; printf released'
